notes: Prod: RiverGlint Spotlight — knowledge search for hospitality franchises (menus, SOPs, real-time FAQs).

Throughput: small scale now (~50 qps peak for search during working hours) but expects seasonal spikes.
Cost sensitivity: high; looking to keep monthly embedding costs < $2k for ~500k tokens/month.
